purpose: positive control: the flat arm must reproduce known TMS superposition behaviour
blind: Euclidean only — no curved arm is trained, so G00 is not breached

E1_dense_keeps_about_d_features.criterion: median recovered <= d+1 = 3 at sparsity 0.0, for N >= 8

E2_sparsity_buys_superposition.criterion: max median recovered at sparsity 0.99 >= 2d = 4, and > dense at some N

E3_monotone_in_sparsity.criterion: median recovered non-decreasing in sparsity, <=1 adjacent inversion

expectations.note: E1 and E2 gate: they are the superposition phenomenon itself. E3 failing alone weakens P2 without invalidating H-MAIN.
